{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash -l
#flux: -N 3
#flux: --time-limit=1h
#flux: --setopt=exec.job-shell.pty.interactive=0

# Note: PBS -l nodes=3:ppn=128 requests 3 nodes with 128 cores per node (384 total cores).
# Flux equivalent uses -N for nodes. You may need to specify '-n 384' at submission time for total tasks.
# Performance consideration: Cores per node not explicitly specified in batch script.
# Note: PBS -l mem=64gb (total memory) does not have a direct Flux equivalent.
# Performance consideration: Memory limits not enforced. Job may be killed if exceeding node memory.
# Note: PBS -r n (not rerunnable) does not have a direct Flux equivalent.
# Performance consideration: Job rerun policy not preserved.
# Note: PBS -j oe (join stdout/stderr) is default behavior in Flux.
# Note: PBS -q directive (starq) does not have a direct Flux equivalent.
# Performance consideration: Queue selection not preserved. Job may run on different hardware/queue.

# go to your working directory containing the batch script, code and data
cd /fs/lustre/cita/zack/jl/dev/LagrangianPerturbationTheory/projectamd
module load openmpi

julia --project -e 'using Pkg; Pkg.instantiate()'
julia --project -e 'using Pkg; Pkg.precompile()'

/fs/lustre/cita/zack/jl/bin/mpiexecjl --project -n 192 julia fft_filter_6144.jl
"
}
